name: Rijksmuseum Data Services
summary: Keyless Linked Art / Linked Data API for the Rijksmuseum collection, including Rembrandt and Vermeer.
description: New data services (replacing the old key-based API) provide a Search API returning Linked Art collections, a Linked Data resolver per object (JSON-LD via content negotiation), OAI-PMH, LDES, IIIF images and full data dumps. Searches filter by creator, type, material, date and more.

auth.notes: The older apiKey-based www.rijksmuseum.nl/api is legacy and deprecated.

required_headers.name: Accept
required_headers.notes: Needed on the id.rijksmuseum.nl resolver to get Linked Art JSON-LD; search returns JSON by default.

endpoints.summary: Search; returns a list of object IDs
Object as Linked Art JSON-LD (send Accept: application/ld+json)

license.name: Public domain / CC0 for data and images of public-domain works

agent_notes: Two-step lookup: the search returns only object IDs, then request each ID from https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/{id} with Accept: application/ld+json. The Linked Art model is verbose, so plan to extract only the fields you need. Page through results with pageToken.
caveats: Search returns only IDs; every object needs a second request.
Old www.rijksmuseum.nl/api with a key is legacy.
